instruction:
In BRL-CAD, open /home/user/Desktop/housing_blank.step. Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). On this machine, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `housing_blank.step`.

Create a shell by cutting a 120 x 80 x 38 mm internal cavity open at the top. Cut a 70 x 30 mm observation window centered on the front face. Add two symmetric top cylindrical bosses of diameter 16 mm and height 8 mm, with boss centers offset by ±30 mm along X from the model center. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl.
